title: Sort Vowels by Frequency
goal: Solve Sort Vowels by Frequency: Count vowels, rank them by frequency and first occurrence, then fill only the original vowel slots.
strategy: Count vowels, rank them by frequency and first occurrence, then fill only the original vowel slots.

phasePurposes.start: Initialize vowel counts and fixed consonant slots.
phasePurposes.count: Scan each character and count vowels.
phasePurposes.rank: Sort groups by frequency, then first occurrence.
phasePurposes.write: Write ranked vowels into the original vowel slots.

edgeCases: Frequency ties follow first occurrence rather than alphabetic order; consonants remain fixed.
inputRules: Enter a JSON string of 1–100,000 lowercase letters.
